name: fundraising
description: Run a raise from Claude Code or from inside Second Brain Studio: screen and verify funds and programs against your own filter chain, build a dated funding plan, draft applications and investor emails, and track every conversation as an indexed layer of your Second Brain. Emails are drafted, never sent.

network.why: Research reads public fund and program pages; applications are filled through the user's own browser; email is written as Gmail drafts, never sent. The Second Brain Link engine itself stays zero-network; this plugin is a separate distribution surface and declares its access here.
endpoints: fund and accelerator websites reached by WebSearch / WebFetch
program application forms (typeform.com, tally.so, fillout.com, docs.google.com/forms, program portals) through the Chrome integration
gmailmcp.googleapis.com via the Gmail connector — draft creation only, never send
